projects.title: NIDAR Dual-Drone Disaster Rescue System
projects.description: Autonomous disaster-response architecture using a scout quadcopter and delivery hexacopter. Designed for large-area survivor search, real-time video, survivor geotagging, speaker communication, obstacle avoidance and precision delivery of survival kits. The onboard stack used Jetson Nano, ROS 2, MAVROS and ArduPilot.

projects.title: Agricultural Disaster Intelligence Drone
projects.description: Agriculture-focused drone system covering four operating states: no-threat crop monitoring, pre-disaster prediction and preparedness, on-disaster rapid mapping, and post-disaster recovery assessment. Designed around aerial scouting, geofencing, GPS, camera data, AI-assisted prediction, crop-health monitoring and pre/post comparison.
